podcast.body: Featured on the 1998 album "Mezzanine," this song was primarily written by Daddy G and includes guest vocals from Jamaican roots singer Horace Andy. "My personal favorite is Mezzanine from 1998, which features this song called Angel. Daddy G was the main songwriter, and the guest vocalist is Horus Andi, a Jamaican root singer."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This track is highlighted as one of the peak moments on the album, possessing an intensity that is almost "too intense to be intense." It features the acclaimed reggae singer Horace Andy on vocals and is heavily influenced by basic reggae and soul movements, played at a very slow tempo, often subtly. "Ingel es una canción muy influenciada por los movimientos básicos del rey de solo que están pasando a cámara muy lenta y no nosamos cuenta."
